name: rystic
description: Run stateful API simulators (Stripe, GitHub, Slack, Shopify and more) from your coding agent: start, seed, move the clock, inspect state and calls, diff state and save runs as test cases.
suggestedPrompts: Start the Stripe simulator and seed a customer with a failing card
Move the simulator clock forward 30 days and show the webhooks it sent
Diff the simulator's state since I started and save this run as a test case
